filesToTouch.what: Three obligations (SIBLING-SET-PLAN §3.1 row goods-movement.js). (1) export const commonTransitConvention = { id: <fresh UUID>, name: 'commonTransitConvention', status: 'mandatory' } — value domain is the NORMALISED enum ADD_MRN_NOW | ADD_MRN_LATER | NO (never the IPAFFS wire values YES/YES_ADD_LATER/NO; the legacy page even mixes casing conventions between its two questions — normalise both). (2) export const movementReferenceNumber = { id: <fresh UUID>, name: 'movementReferenceNumber', applyTo: equalsGate(commonTransitConvention, 'ADD_MRN_NOW', { inScope: true, status: 'mandatory', reasons: [movementReferenceNumberReason] }, { inScope: false }) } — exact signature exemplar: sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/import-reason.js purposeInInternalMarket (read live this session); reasons object shape { code: 'obligation.movementReferenceNumber.applicable.becauseAddMrnNow', explanation: 'movementReferenceNumber applies when commonTransitConvention is ADD_MRN_NOW' }. (3) export const usingGvms = { id: <fresh UUID>, name: 'usingGvms', status: 'mandatory' } — canonical value is a BOOLEAN (obligation-field-map inc-022). NEVER validate or commit movementReferenceNumber when CTC is not ADD_MRN_NOW (never commit a hidden value; the engine purges out-of-scope data). notes: 1:1 carry of inc-022 (page spec goods-movement-services.json — adversarially re-verified; the page is DATA capture, not a GVMS/NCTS integration). EXEMPLARS pinned live this session: sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/import-reason.js (equalsGate signature + reasons-object shape + purge-on-flip comment idiom), features/import-reason/controller.js (single-page collecting idiom), features/contact/template.njk (govukRadios macro usage), features/commodities/evaluation.js:51 (binding convert idiom). DECISIONS (headless): (1) TWO-TIER COLLAPSED — legacy lets you save the page with both questions blank and only blocks at backend submission (@NotNull on provideCtcMrn/isGVMSRoute); the spec flags this as a policy choice, and pp-009 records the set as single-layer Joi-voice, so both radios are required at the point of answer, adopting the legacy submission strings 'Select if using the Common Transit Convention (CTC)' / 'Select if using the Goods Vehicle Movement Service (GVMS)' as the page errors; (2) MRN error = the single canonical 'Enter a valid Movement Reference Number' for empty/length/pattern (c-018 one string per field; matches the legacy LIVE wiring — the two more-specific legacy strings are dead copy there); regex copied verbatim /^\d{2}[A-Za-z0-9]{16}$/ with trim-before-validate (legacy trims too); (3) caption 'Transport' kept spec-verbatim even though goods-movement is its own hub spoke — spokes 5 and 6 are both transport-family and mirror-existing wins over inventing a new caption; (4) enum + boolean normalisation: CTC stored as ADD_MRN_NOW|ADD_MRN_LATER|NO, usingGvms canonical boolean via binding convert (fixes the legacy value-casing inconsistency and the string-vs-boolean split); (5) MRN as a gated SCALAR obligation with equalsGate — the engine's purge-on-flip exactly reproduces the legacy delete-on-save behaviour (including 'add later' clearing a saved MRN), so no controller-side delete code exists; (6) 'Save and review' change-from-review button variant and etag optimistic concurrency NOT built (house: change-context via kit + whole-document last-write-wins, Open Q 3); (7) legacy per-CHED-type render gates (enableCtcQuestion/enableGvmsQuestion) are dead code for a CHED-PP-only set — both questions render unconditionally; (8) conditional-reveal JS comes from the stock govuk-frontend bundle already loaded by the shared layout — no webpack entry needed. FIXES-NOT-PORTED from the spec's nonStandardPatterns: orphaned CTC hint (confirmed WCAG-relevant defect axe cannot see), href='#' back link with bespoke classes, hand-authored fieldset markup, two-equal-primary-buttons, the global aria-allowed-attr axe suppression (deliberately dropped — scan with the rule ON, including the expanded-reveal and error states legacy never scanned). Check-answers row: features/check-answers does not exist until pp-038 — that increment owns the goods-movement card rows; no omission here. RULINGS APPLIED: c-004 (There is a problem), c-014 family (proper heading structure), c-018 (canonical Joi-voice strings), FD-5/FD-6 (set-owned records), obligation-field-map inc-022 (goodsMovementServices.* nested DTO object).
openQuestions: Deferred-MRN flow is unmapped: legacy has a separate add_ncts_mrn page (outside the 28-page CHED-PP journey map, never traced) where an 'add later' MRN is presumably captured. Pass 1 builds NO second MRN page, and in this model ADD_MRN_LATER leaves movementReferenceNumber out of scope — so a notification CAN be submitted with 'add later' and no MRN. Product must confirm whether submission should be blocked or a later capture point added (new scope if so).

Data-loss semantics carried from the spec: switching from 'add MRN now' to 'add later'/'No' wipes a saved MRN with no warning (legacy behaviour, reproduced here as the engine's purge contract). Intended? If product wants a confirmation step, that is new scope.

MRN regex is looser than the hint promises: /^\d{2}[A-Za-z0-9]{16}$/ enforces no country code, so '24123456789AB0123X' passes. Copied verbatim pending the real NCTS MRN spec — confirm before real submissions matter.

MRN error message granularity: c-018 single canonical string chosen ('Enter a valid Movement Reference Number'), but the spec notes GDS favours per-failure-mode messages and legacy defines (dead) specific strings for length/pattern. Content-designer call; wiring is one copy key + validator mapping per mode if ruled.

aria-allowed-attr: the legacy suite globally suppresses this axe rule blaming govuk-frontend's conditional-radio aria-expanded. This increment scans with the rule ON using the stock macro; if the violation reproduces on pristine macro markup it is an upstream govuk-frontend issue to raise (with the plant page as the repro), not to suppress — the implementor should report, not disable.

'GMS declaration' name-clash (spec): the legacy journey has a separate earlier GMS-declaration page, relationship to GVMS=Yes unknown and never exercised for CHED-PP; it is NOT in the 39-page map and is not built. If product links GVMS=Yes to a declaration requirement, that is new scope.

GVMS=Yes and the full CTC Yes branches were never exercised by any CHED-PP trace or test (cross-CHED evidence only) — built per spec/source but with no observed CHED-PP behaviour to mirror downstream.
